source_request: 접어 둔 리넨 냅킨을 주인공으로 차분한 정물 사진을 만들어 줘. 집에서 식탁을 차리기 전의 느낌이면 좋겠고, 음식이나 사람은 넣지 말아 줘.
interpreted_intent: Requester-owned: Folded linen napkin as protagonist; Calm still life; Home table before setting; No food or people. Authorial choices within open dimensions: Light wooden table; Pale oatmeal cloth color; Slightly uneven folded edges; Side daylight; Gently downward view. A crisp shop display and a napkin resting before a home meal were considered; the latter follows the requested sense of a domestic table about to be prepared.
subject: folded linen napkin before table setting
setting: light wooden dining table in a quiet home corner
event: folded napkin waits on the table before a meal setting
visual_priorities: simple object shape and surrounding space
baseline_prompt_en: A folded linen napkin waits on a light wooden dining table, ready for the table to be set. The cloth is the central subject of a calm domestic still life. Its folded edges lie slightly unevenly, giving the arrangement the ordinary care of something put aside for later. Empty tabletop surrounds the napkin and keeps attention on its shape. The linen is a pale oatmeal color. Daylight enters from the side, and the camera looks down gently enough to show the folded cloth's height as well as its top.
